OnbWelcomeBody: Dictation that runs entirely on your device, in Chinese, English, or both at once.
OnbMicBody: The microphone is on only while you dictate.
OnbMicDenied: Microphone access is off. Turn it on for Arion in System Settings.
OnbMicTest: Say something. The bars should move.
OnbAXBody: Accessibility access lets Arion put text where your cursor is.
OnbAXWaiting: Waiting for access in System Settings.
OnbModelBody: Recognition downloads once and then works offline. Polishing is optional and also runs only on this Mac.
OnbShortcutBody: Press it once to start and again to finish. Esc cancels.
OnbTryBody: Click the box, press your shortcut, and say a sentence.
OnbDoneBody: Arion waits in the menu bar. Press your shortcut in any app.

IMERemoveFailed: The input source could not be removed
SystemMicrophoneUsage: Arion listens only while you dictate. Speech is recognized on this Mac.
ShortcutNeedsModifierWindows: Include Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win
PolishDetail: Cleans up self-corrections, fillers and repeats as you talk, on this Mac
PolishUnsupported: Needs a Mac with Apple silicon
MatchAppDetail: Formats emails, work messages, coding prompts and searches for the app or website you type in, decided on this Mac
ContextCursorDetail: Reads a few lines before and after the cursor to spell names and continue your text
ContextScreenDetail: Recognizes the text in the window you're typing in, on this Mac. Nothing is saved
ContextHistoryDetail: Remembers your last few dictations in each app for 30 minutes, in memory only
LearnEditsDetail: When you fix a word Arion inserted, it spells it your way next time
OnbSyncTitle: Keep it local, or add sync
OnbSyncBody: Dictation, memory and learning work fully offline without an account. Sign in only to sync memory across your devices.
OnbSignInSync: Sign in and set up sync
AccNoDecrypt: Signing in never lets AstraFoundry read your memory. Only your devices hold its key.
AccWaiting: Finish signing in in your browser, then return to Arion.
AccSignOutKeeps: Signing out keeps this device's keys and memory.
AccSyncAvailable: Hosted sync is available for this account
AccSyncDeviceLater: Setting up this device for sync isn't in this version of Arion yet.
AccWaitlistOpen: Hosted sync opens through a waitlist
AccWaitlistEntitled: This account already has hosted sync
AccWaitlistClosed: The hosted sync waitlist is closed
AccSelfHosted: Self-hosted sync needs no waitlist, and every local feature works either way.
AccErrState: The browser's reply didn't match this sign-in. Try again.
AccErrDenied: Sign-in was declined in the browser.
AccErrAuthorization: AstraFoundry didn't authorize the sign-in. Try again.
AccErrToken: Couldn't finish signing in with AstraFoundry. Try again.
AccErrDiscovery: Couldn't reach AstraFoundry. Check your connection and try again.
AccErrIssuer: AstraFoundry's sign-in service isn't set up the way Arion expects.
AccErrStore: Arion couldn't use this device's secure credential storage.
AccErrSessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
AccErrRefresh: Couldn't refresh your account. Try again.
AccRevokeUnconfirmed: Signed out on this device, but AstraFoundry didn't confirm that the session was revoked.
AccErrEntitlement: Couldn't read this account's sync access. Try again.
AccErrLoopback: Arion couldn't receive the sign-in from your browser. Try again.
AccErrGeneric: Something went wrong with your AstraFoundry account.
